arrkit: a library the radarr, sonarr and seerr bots share, not a bot of its own; their manifests cover it
github-releases: has no commands: it only polls GitHub and posts, so there is nothing to type; its tests cover the feed
starboard: has no commands: it reacts to reactions, which a text smoke step cannot add; its tests cover them
uptime-relay: has no commands: it answers webhooks from an uptime monitor on its own port, outside a chat channel
